title: custom login is disabled in XSUAA runtime
runtime: SAP BTP Cloud Foundry / XSUAA / HANA
testCommand: Browser Control authenticated AppRouter request plus bounded HANA aggregate readback
actualResult: HTTP 405 returned with the safe SAP BTP sign-in direction. No bearer/access token was returned. The mapped PM profile was identical before and after the call. HANA AuthSessions remained 0; Users, Bugs, attachments and outbox counts were unchanged.
assertions: HTTP 405 returned with the safe SAP BTP sign-in direction.
The mapped PM profile was identical before and after the call.
HANA AuthSessions remained 0; Users, Bugs, attachments and outbox counts were unchanged.
limitations: Covers the deployed custom-login denial only; it does not replace the separate unmapped, multi-role, or mismatch cases.
